people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: They chose new gods. Then war was in the gates. Was there a shield or spear seen among forty thousand in Israel?
translations.bsb: When they chose new gods, then war came to their gates. Not a shield or spear was found among forty thousand in Israel.
translations.kjv: They chose new gods; then was war in the gates: was there a shield or spear seen among forty thousand in Israel?
